title: Unify Dashboard admin wallet/admin recognition into a single canonical state

requirements.summary: Derive and render the Dashboard admin wallet status from one canonical source so balance and admin-recognition messaging can never disagree.
acceptanceCriteria: When the admin wallet balance renders as a number, the UI does not render any 'not recognized as admin'/'unauthorized' messaging anywhere on the Dashboard for the same session.
When the caller is not an admin, the Dashboard shows only the 'not an admin' messaging and does not show an admin wallet balance.
When the admin wallet balance request fails for reasons other than authorization, the Dashboard shows an error state (not the 'not an admin' state).
All user-facing status strings remain in English.

file_operations.description: Create a small hook that converts useGetAdminWalletBalance() + authentication state into a single discriminated admin-wallet UI state (e.g., not-logged-in/loading/unauthorized/error/success) and exposes balance only for the success state.

Refactor the Dashboard admin wallet badge + top card to render strictly from the canonical admin wallet UI state (from useAdminWalletStatus) so only one coherent state is shown at a time; ensure error state takes precedence over any cached/stale balance, and ensure the unauthorized message renders only when the canonical state is unauthorized.

Update AdminDiagnosticsCard to use the same canonical admin wallet UI state for wallet status/balance rendering so it cannot contradict the Dashboard admin wallet display; do not gate its visibility based on a separate admin signal that can disagree with the wallet status.

requirements.summary: Show/hide Dashboard admin-only actions using the same canonical admin signal as the displayed admin wallet balance.
acceptanceCriteria: If the admin wallet balance is successfully fetched (non-null), the “Distribute Funds to User” card is available on the Dashboard.
If the admin wallet balance is null due to authorization, the “Distribute Funds to User” card is not shown.
There is no state where admin-only actions are hidden while an admin wallet balance is displayed.

file_operations.description: Remove dependence on useIsCallerAdmin() for Dashboard admin-only action gating; show the “Distribute Funds to User” card whenever the canonical admin wallet UI state is success (balance available), and hide it for unauthorized/loading/error/not-logged-in states so it can never disagree with the displayed admin wallet balance.

requirements.summary: Differentiate authorization failures from non-auth failures in the admin wallet balance query so only true auth failures map to null and all other failures surface as errors.
acceptanceCriteria: A non-auth backend failure (e.g., temporary actor/connection issue) results in an error state in the Dashboard admin wallet UI, not a 'Not recognized as admin' state.
A true backend authorization failure results in a 'not an admin/unauthorized' UI state and a null admin wallet balance in React Query data.

file_operations.description: Add a shared helper (e.g., isAuthorizationError(error: unknown): boolean) to reliably classify true authorization failures based on backend trap/message patterns, distinct from network/actor/other runtime failures.

Harden useGetAdminWalletBalance() to return null only when isAuthorizationError(...) is true; otherwise rethrow so React Query sets an error state. Also ensure Dashboard consumers can prefer the query error state over any cached data to avoid false 'success + unauthorized' mismatches.
